definitions.full: H2558. chomets חֹ֫מֶץ noun masculine vinegar — ׳ח absolute Prov 10:26 3 t.; construct Num 6:3 (twice in verse); — a common condiment Ruth 2:14 , forbidden to Nazirite ( ׳ח יין and ׳ח שֵׁכָר ) Num 6:3 (twice in verse) (P), offered (in cruelty) to a thirsty man Psa 69:22 (figurative for harshness lack of sympathy); in simile of sluggard לַשִּׁנַּיִם כַּחֹמֶץ Prov 10:26 , ׳ח עַלנָֿ֑תֶר 25:20 vinegar on nitre (simile of merry songs for the heavy-hearted).
